items.t: SolarEdge Slides 5% as Rising Yields Weigh on Solar Stocks; Sunrun Drops 4%, Enphase Falls 3%
items.sum: A blowout earnings beat sounded like good news for SolarEdge, yet its stock is sliding with the whole solar sector. The culprit sits in the bond market, and some solar names feel it far more than others.

items.t: Wall Street Analysts See a 45.07% Upside in Sunrun (RUN): Can the Stock Really Move This High?
items.sum: The average of price targets set by Wall Street analysts indicates a potential upside of 45.1% in Sunrun (RUN). While the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric is questionable, the positive trend in earnings estimate revisions might translate into an upside in the stock.

items.t: Are Investors Undervaluing Sunrun (RUN) Right Now?
